name: Iut.Frobenioid.OrbitObj / Iut.Frobenioid.OrbitHom
type_or_signature: structure OrbitObj (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] where (H : Subgroup G) (isOpen : IsOpen (H : Set G)) ;; structure OrbitHom (A B : OrbitObj G) where (toFun : G / A.H -> G / B.H) (map_smul : forall (g : G) (x : G / A.H), toFun (g * x) = g * toFun x) ;; instance : Category (OrbitObj G)
premises: [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]; OrbitHom.injective_of_mono (163) and OrbitHom.bijective_of_isFSM (178) additionally need [IsTopologicalGroup G]
usability_note: Objects = transitive G-sets G/H for OPEN subgroups H, morphisms = G-equivariant maps; this is B^temp(Pi)^0, the tempered base category of [EtTh] sec.3. Equivariance is a FIELD (map_smul), so every morphism is equivariant by construction. Genuine theorems in the same file: OrbitHom.surjective (87, equivariant maps of transitive G-sets are surjective), injective_of_mono (163), bijective_of_isFSM (178), OrbitObj.isConnected (116), OrbitObj.totallyEpimorphic (121). Does NOT supply local/global objects, divisors or a descent datum; no Galois action on prime-strips is defined here.

name: Iut.Frobenioid.IsFrobenioid (field pullback_surj)
type_or_signature: structure IsFrobenioid (_P : C ~> Elem Phi) : Prop extends IsPreFrobenioid P where base_surj : ... ;; preStep_span : ... ;; pullback_surj : forall (A : C) (X : D) (f : X ~> base P A), exists (B : C) (phi : B ~> A) (e : base P B ~= X), IsPullback P phi /\ e.hom ~> f = Base P phi ;; frobenius : ...
premises: {D : Type u} [Category D] {Phi : DivMonoid D} {C : Type u'} [Category C] (P : C ~> Elem Phi)
usability_note: TRAP: pullback_surj, base_surj, preStep_span, frobenius, coslice_surj, slice_surj are FIELDS of a Prop-valued structure, i.e. the existence of pullback morphisms is ASSUMED for whatever P is handed in. IsFrobenioid constructs nothing and proves no existence: it is a certificate interface whose clause (i)(c) is literally 'every f : X -> A_D is, up to iso over A_D, the base of a pullback morphism'. IsPullback itself is only the universal-property predicate (Defs.lean 135-137). Do not quote this as 'pullback exists in IUT'.

name: Iut.Frobenioid.Model.isFrobenioid (with Model.pullback_surj, Model.frobenius)
type_or_signature: theorem isFrobenioid [IsConnected D] [TotallyEpimorphic D] : IsFrobenioid P  (P := Model.toElem Phi B divB)
premises: {D : Type u} [Category D] {Phi : DivMonoid D} {B : GrpOn D} {divB : DivHom B Phi.toGrpOn} [IsConnected D] [TotallyEpimorphic D]
usability_note: This IS an existence proof and a construction, clause by clause, for the MODEL Frobenioid. The pullback object is built literally as <<Y, Phi.pb f X.alpha>> with morphism mk1 f 0 ... (Model.pullback_surj, 121-126); the degree-n Frobenius object as <<X.base, n * X.alpha>> with uniqueness up to unique iso (Model.frobenius, 130-146). Boundary: Phi (divisorial monoid), B (rational-function monoid) and divB are SUPPLIED DATA, not built from a curve; and it is a model Frobenioid (object = base + divisor), so it does not by itself produce the IUT joint object or its descent. A second, non-model discharge of the same class is Angular.isFrobenioid (Iut/Frobenioid/Angular/Frobenioid.lean:106), where pullback morphisms are exactly the isomorphisms - a degenerate case.

name: Iut.Wall.ValBPS / Iut.Wall.ValBPS.Iso (constructor qVal)
type_or_signature: structure ValBPS (V : Type) (bad : Finset V) where (C : Type) ([AddCommGroup C]) ([Module R C]) (finrank_eq_one : Module.finrank R C = 1) (localPilot : V -> C) (localPilot_ne_zero : forall v, localPilot v /= 0) (pilot_ne_zero : (sum v in bad, localPilot v) /= 0)
premises: no premises beyond the fields; ValBPS.Iso (231-235) needs nothing extra; an instance is constructed by qVal (Iut/Wall/Pilots.lean:106) from L : LocalDegrees V with L.bad nonempty and L.deg positive
usability_note: Closest existing match to 'a collection of local objects + one global object + identifications': one global real line C, the local pieces given as localPilot : V -> C inside it, and Iso = an R-linear iso carrying local piece to local piece (map_localPilot is a field). NOT a localization isomorphism: the rho_v are already applied and absorbed into localPilot, so no map C_v -> C^- is recorded as data. Structure only (allows an object with these conditions); existence is NOT automatic and is supplied separately by qVal. Genuine derived results: pilot (196), sumMap/PF (201/210), Iso.map_pilot (253, from the field), valIso_subsingleton (296), eta_unique (329).

name: Iut.ThetaLink.RlfMuStrip / Iut.ThetaLink.RlfMuStrip.Iso
type_or_signature: structure RlfMuStrip (D : InitialThetaData.{0}) where (unit : FMuStrip D) (val : ValBPS (Pl D) D.bpsDegrees.bad) ;; structure Iso (P Q : RlfMuStrip D) where (unit : P.unit.Iso Q.unit) (val : ValBPS.Iso P.val Q.val)
premises: D : InitialThetaData.{0} (IUT I Definition 3.1 data; the repo builds it from an elliptic curve via EllipticCurveData.thetaData)
usability_note: The repo's own encoding of IUT II Definition 4.9(viii) F^{box-plus-bowtie x mu}-prime-strip, whose docstring states the original is 'a collection (C^boxplus, Prime(C^boxplus) ~= V, F^{...}, {rho_v})' = global realified Frobenioid + per-v local data + rho_v. CRITICAL BOUNDARY, stated by the module docstring itself ('Simplifications'): the Frobenioid C^boxplus and the splitting monoids O^tri are recorded ONLY through their realified value groups and local pilots, so rho_v are not structure fields. Morphisms are a pair, not a poly-morphism, and the value part is unique (Iso.val_eq 208; isoEquivUnit 214), so the whole 'which isomorphism' indeterminacy sits in the unit part. Existence is conditional: qStrip (239) / gauStrip construct one only from a given ThetaPmEllNFHT, not for arbitrary D. Related genuine theorem: Iso.map_pilot (192), nonempty_iso_iff (199).

name: Iut.LogLink.abs_det_archIndMap
type_or_signature: theorem abs_det_archIndMap : |LinearMap.det (archIndMap c sigma eps)| = 1  (archIndMap c sigma eps = PiTensorProduct.map (fun j => archFactorMap (sigma j) (eps j)), defined in Iut/Concrete/LocalConstruct/ArchIndAut.lean:74)
premises: {K : Type u} [Field K] [NumberField K] {iota : Type} [Fintype iota] (c : iota -> Place K) (sigma : forall j, ArchFactor K (c j) ~=a[R] ArchFactor K (c j)) (eps : iota -> Int-units); proof consumes Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap, image_archLogShell_archIndMap (318), haar_archLogShell_pos, isCompact_archLogShell
usability_note: Genuine determinant-of-a-tensor-product statement for the archimedean indeterminacies (Ind1)/(Ind2): det of the map tensor-product_j (eps_j * sigma_j). PROVED, not assumed. Group functoriality in the same file: archIndMap_mul (372), archIndMap_one (381); consequences: haar_image (339), componentVol_image (344), image_mem_admissible (350). Boundaries: LinearMap.det here is the determinant of a real endomorphism measured against a chosen Haar measure; it is NOT a determinant of a line bundle or of a Frobenioid object, gives NO degree/log-volume transformation formula for tensor powers of a line, and says nothing at the non-archimedean places or about the prime-strip.

name: Iut.Frobenioid.GlobalRealified.degree_frobenius (with degree_hom)
type_or_signature: theorem degree_frobenius {X Y : GlobalRealified K} (phi : X ~> Y) (h : IsFrobeniusType (Model.toElem (phiRlf K) (bRlf K) (divBRlf K)) phi) : Y.degree = phi.deg * X.degree ;; theorem degree_hom (305-312) : (phi.deg : R) * X.degree + degArith K phi.div = Y.degree
premises: K with [Field K] [NumberField K] plus the model data phiRlf K, bRlf K, divBRlf K; the hypothesis h is an IsFrobeniusType CERTIFICATE
usability_note: TRAP: degree_frobenius is proved by taking h.1.2 (a FIELD of the supplied certificate, giving Div phi = 0) and rewriting degree_hom - so it PROJECTS A FIELD out of a handed-in certificate rather than constructing a degree map. degree_hom (305) is a real identity. Since degFr = n exactly for the n-th Frobenius/tensor-power object (Model.frobenius, ModelFrobenioid.lean:130), this is the nearest existing 'degree transformation under tensor power'; also degree_eq_of_iso (321), mul_degree_le (315), degree_ofBundle = Arakelov deg (338), degreeNorm (302). It is the FROBENIOID degree, not the normalized log-volume/determinant degree of cQ3.

name: Iut4Sec1.arithmeticDivisorDegree_pullback / Iut4Sec1.normalizedArithmeticDivisorDegree_pullback
type_or_signature: theorem arithmeticDivisorDegree_pullback (D : ArithmeticDivisor K) : arithmeticDivisorDegree (arithmeticDivisorPullback (L := L) D) = (Module.finrank K L : R) * arithmeticDivisorDegree D ;; theorem normalizedArithmeticDivisorDegree_pullback (D) : normalizedArithmeticDivisorDegree (pullback D) = normalizedArithmeticDivisorDegree D
premises: {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] [NumberField K] [NumberField L] [Algebra K L]; base change arithmeticDivisorPullback (58) is defined by ramificationIdx on primes over and inertiaDeg at the infinite places
usability_note: Genuine base-change degree transformation, computed place by place (uses NumberField.InfinitePlace.sum_inertiaDeg_eq_finrank, Module.finrank_mul_finrank), not a certificate projection: the RAW degree scales by [L : K] and the NORMALIZED one is invariant. Its own boundary (README, 'Current scope'): the globally normalized quotient of IUT IV Definition 1.9(ii) is deliberately NOT claimed - the numerator is invariant while the local-degree denominator scales by the extension degree; rawLocalDegreeRatio_pullback (315) covers the related ratio. This is an arithmetic-divisor degree on a number field, not the degree of an IUT log-shell or Theta-pivot, and it carries no tensor power.
